description: Emacs `save-buffer` with default settings: the `#notes.org#` autosave is discarded, the previous contents are renamed to a `notes.org~` backup, the new `notes.org` is written, and the `.#notes.org` lock file is released. Note `.#notes.org` still ends in `.org` yet must be filtered as an artifact by its `.#` prefix. One logical save; `notes.org` must coalesce to exactly one FileChanged. Offsets are milliseconds from the start of the save burst. Modeled on documented Emacs save/backup/lock mechanics — not a live capture.
